note: Corps of Engineers campground on Rough River Lake near McDaniels, on a wooded point and bay beside the dam-area marina. The open lakeside sites are B031-B035 on the loop B point and F110-F114 at the loop F tip; most other sites sit back in the trees. Swim area, boat ramp ($5 a day) and fish-cleaning station. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on rec.gov: 158 sites, $20-38 (loop I non-electric $20, electric $34, three full-hookup $38; doubles $48/$68), 50A, sewer at 3 sites, showers/dump/flush toilets, 14-night limit, season Apr 15 (2027) to Nov 1 (2026). Lakefront CONFIRMED: B031/B032/B034/B035 and F110-F113 are 7-25 m from the high-water edge over open gravel and grass.
flags: WATERFRONT CONFIRMED (stored lakefront): rec.gov tags 63 sites 'Lakefront' (loose). Plotted on Esri imagery, the open-ground lakeside pads are B031 (37.620765,-86.455079), B032 (37.620689,-86.455188), B034 (37.620522,-86.455307) and B035 (37.620329,-86.455293) on the loop B point, ~15-20 m from the vegetation/high-water line over open grass and gravel with a gentle sand-and-rock shore; and F110 (37.621803,-86.457848), F111 (37.621679,-86.457690), F112 (37.622003,-86.456772), F113 (37.622097,-86.456489), ~7-25 m from the high-water line over open grass. All are 50A electric, RV-permitted, 30-45 ft spurs, sold by the night. Many other 'Lakefront' tags (G, H, C, D, E loops) are under canopy and would be views.
